convert_ernie4_5_vl_moe_config: convert an Ernie 4.5 VL MoE model config from Baidu format to Hugging Face format and save to a directory
convert_ernie4_5_vl_moe_tokenizer: convert an Ernie 4.5 VL MoE tokenizer from Baidu format to Hugging Face format with multimodal special tokens
convert_ernie4_5_vl_moe_processor: convert an Ernie 4.5 VL MoE processor including image, video processors and tokenizer to Hugging Face format
convert_vision_config_to_hf: convert vision-related configuration keys from the original Ernie 4.5 VL MoE format to Hugging Face vision config format
convert_text_config_to_hf: convert text config keys from Ernie 4.5 VL MoE format to Hugging Face format with MoE layer type mappings
run_convert_ernie4_5_vl_moe_cli: run the Ernie 4.5 VL MoE conversion script via CLI with checkpoint path and output folder arguments
